Chief of Staff / Founder's Office
KiteCraft AI
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About KiteCraft:
We build generative AI enterprise agents automating customer support and back-office ops.

Role Overview:
• Serve as force multiplier to the CEO across product strategy, investor relations, and GTM.
• Manage cross-functional company OKRs, executive hiring, and sprint priorities.
• Analyze unit economics, burn rate, and enterprise sales pipeline.

Requirements:
• 2-4 years experience in Founder's Office, management consulting, or VC.
• MBA is preferred (IIM / ISB / Tier-1).
• High agility, generalist mindset, and comfort with AI workflows.
